name: Virus-proof recoded factory bacteria
effect: three RNA letters spell one amino acid
how: Factory bacteria whose whole genome has been rewritten so they never use certain three-letter codons, then the machinery that reads those codons is removed. Viruses still rely on those codons, so their proteins come out garbled inside the cell and they cannot spread through the fermentation tanks.
why: Rewriting the genetic dictionary itself makes cells immune to every virus.
